title: Growing up with jazz, her father's piano and records
summary: Jazz was all around her; her father played piano, had other musicians in and kept a good record collection.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I think for as long as I can remember. As long as you can remember?
What did you think of it when you first came?
I didn't think anything of it when I first heard it because it was all around me.
When you first thought about it, did you just like it?
Naturally I always liked it because my father had a great deal to do with it and he played it more so than any other kind of music and so it just became more or less part of me.
He played instruments or he played records?
Both. He played the piano then he had other people in to play other instruments and then he has a pretty good collection of it on records.
